test_title: PYST 31 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 24 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Fill in the blank with the correctly spelt word.

The philosopher elaborated on _________ tendencies in human behavior.
solution:
The correct answer is** option 4, i.e. anthropomorphous.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Anthropomorphous** is the correctly spelled word.
 
• The word **anthropomorphous** is an adjective that means 'having human characteristics or form
